svg.title: A biometric scanner rejects a correctly placed work-worn hand.
svg.desc: A manual worker's hand rests properly on damp scanner glass, but the blank identity outline fails to complete. Riju and Cecil watch the second rejection.
svg.text: Page 12, panel 1 · Tight over-scanner view of a rejected hand
